definition: Maliciously tampering with training data so a model learns a hidden backdoor or degrades on certain inputs.
details: An attacker inserts mislabeled or crafted examples before training; the model then behaves normally on most inputs but fails or triggers on attacker-chosen ones. Poisoning matters for both centralized training and systems that fine-tune on user-supplied or web-scraped data.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. In plain words: Maliciously tampering with training data so a model learns a hidden backdoor or degrades on certain inputs. Here is how it actually plays out: An attacker inserts mislabeled or crafted examples before training; the model then behaves normally on most inputs but fails or triggers on attacker-chosen ones. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Data Poisoning.

citation.title: Poisoning Attacks against Support Vector Machines
